name: Eyeris
description: Self-hosted photo manager for NAS and local libraries. Eyeris scans your photos, generates thumbnails, and gives you a fast searchable gallery — all on your own hardware. AI-powered image descriptions and tagging are offloaded to a connected A-Eye instance; Eyeris imports the results automatically. No cloud, no subscriptions, no local LLM required. Features include: A-Eye integration for AI descriptions and tags, EXIF and GPS metadata, duplicate and blurry photo detection, album organisation, SearXNG web image search, and a real-time dashboard.

paths.name: Photo Directory
paths.description: Your photo library — local folder or SMB/NFS mount point.

paths.name: Thumbnails
paths.description: Where Eyeris stores generated thumbnails and face crop cache.

paths.name: Database
paths.description: SQLite database storage. Ignored if DB_HOST is set.

paths.name: Config file (.env)
paths.description: Persistent config file — Eyeris reads and writes settings here. Create an empty file at this path before first run.

ports.name: Web UI Port
ports.description: Port for the Eyeris web interface and API.

variables.name: NAS Host
variables.description: IP or hostname of your NAS. Leave empty if photos are already accessible via the Photo Directory path above.

variables.name: NAS Shares
variables.description: Comma-separated share names to scan, e.g. photos,media,camera-uploads

variables.name: A-Eye URL
variables.description: URL of your A-Eye instance, e.g. http://192.168.1.100:7171. Connect A-Eye to enable AI image descriptions and automatic tagging.

variables.name: A-Eye Username
variables.description: Username for HTTP Basic Auth on your A-Eye instance. Leave empty if A-Eye is unauthenticated.

variables.name: A-Eye Password
variables.description: Password for HTTP Basic Auth on your A-Eye instance.

variables.name: SearXNG URL
variables.description: URL of a SearXNG instance for the web image search feature (optional).

variables.name: Scan Workers
variables.description: Number of parallel scan workers. Raise to 3-4 on fast systems; lower if your system struggles.

variables.name: Scan Interval (minutes)
variables.description: How often Eyeris rescans for new photos.

variables.name: Scan Schedule Enabled
variables.description: Set to true to restrict scanning to a time window (e.g. overnight only).

variables.name: Scan Schedule Start
variables.description: Start of the allowed scan window (24-hour HH:MM). Only used when SCAN_SCHEDULE_ENABLED=true.

variables.name: Scan Schedule End
variables.description: End of the allowed scan window (24-hour HH:MM). An end time before the start time crosses midnight.

variables.name: MariaDB Host
variables.description: MariaDB host IP or hostname. Leave empty to use the built-in SQLite database (recommended for most users).
